research.notes: Only the organization's own website could be reached. Registry checks (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer returned HTTP 429, IRS search returned 403, Charity Navigator found nothing) and further web searches were unavailable, so the EIN and CA entity number are not confirmed and no independent source corroborates the identity. The site does not mention OUSD or human trafficking prevention. Confidence is medium rather than high for those reasons; a reviewer should confirm via ProPublica or the CA Secretary of State before publishing.

profile.summary: Dream Youth Clinic is a nonprofit in Oakland, California that provides no-cost, youth-led health services. It focuses on Black youth, youth of color and gender-expansive youth. Its programs include medical services, youth health groups, youth leadership programs and digital health education.
